category_edits.rationale: Apply smooth norm compression e/sqrt(1+||e||²) to tied item embeddings in all four category models. This preserves small-embedding magnitude differences while limiting large norms. History, target and candidate lookups share the transformation, with padding exactly zero. Dimension, input scaling, HSTU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer remain unchanged. The predictor writer already imports HSTURec from train.py, so inference automatically uses the same transformation with unchanged checkpoint shapes.

change_summary: Use smooth norm compression for all tied item embedding lookups, preserving zero padding and training/predictor consistency across all four datasets.
